answer: A decaying reputation score makes Sybil stockpiling useless: an agent earns standing only from recent verified work, and that standing fades like pigment left in sunlight unless it is renewed by fresh contributions. An attacker could create a thousand sparrow accounts, but each would need continuous genuine work to stay credible, and a sudden swarm arriving like a zephyr would still carry near-zero reputation, so the network simply ignores it until it has proven itself over time.
